profile.audio-flac.name: Audio · FLAC
profile.audio-opus.name: Audio · Opus

profile.gif.name: Animated GIF

queue.title: Queue
queue.clearHint: Remove every file from the list (running conversions are stopped)
queue.needFfmpeg: Set up ffmpeg first, then add files.
queue.alreadyAdded: Those files are already in the queue.
queue.nothingFound: No video or audio files found there.
queue.skippedDuplicates_one: 1 file was already in the queue.
queue.skippedDuplicates_other: {count} files were already in the queue.
queue.estimateHint: Rough estimate from the source's bitrate and the encoder (often within ±40 %). For an exact figure: Preview 10 seconds.
queue.bitrateTotal: Total bitrate of the source (the file doesn't list the video on its own)
queue.projectedHint: Projected from what has been written so far. Gets more exact as the file progresses.
queue.customSettings: This file has its own settings
queue.fellBack: The GPU encode failed ({reason}), so it was redone on the CPU.
status.fellBack: Finished on the CPU after the GPU failed
name.suffixedHint: A file with this name exists (or another file in the queue wants it), so a number is added: “name (2)”.
name.overwritesHint: A file with this name exists and will be replaced (collision rule: Overwrite).
name.skippedHint: A file with this name already exists and the collision rule is Skip.
note.videoCopyReencoded: This video codec can't go into the chosen container, so the video will be re-encoded.
note.audioCopyReencoded: Some audio tracks can't be copied into this container and will be re-encoded.
note.audioCodecSwapped: The chosen audio codec doesn't fit this container; its default codec is used instead.
note.tenBitUnsupported: This encoder can't do 10-bit, so the output will be 8-bit.
note.tonemapUnavailable: HDR → SDR needs the zscale filter, which this ffmpeg lacks. Colours may look washed out.
note.burnUnavailable: Burning text subtitles needs libass, which this ffmpeg lacks. Subtitles are skipped.
note.bitmapSubsDropped: Picture-based subtitles (PGS/DVD) can't be stored in this container and are dropped. Use MKV or burn them in.
note.targetSizeNoDuration: The file's length is unknown, so a quality setting is used instead of the target size.
note.ceilingUnsupported: This graphics card can't cap the bitrate in CQ mode, so the file was encoded on the GPU with the CQ value alone, without the ceiling.
warn.videoCodecContainer: This container doesn't support the chosen video codec.
warn.audioCodecContainer: This container doesn't support the chosen audio codec. Its default will be used.
warn.nothingToEncode: Audio is switched off, so there is nothing to put in an audio file.
warn.burnNeedsEncode: Burning in subtitles needs the video to be re-encoded, not copied.
warn.filtersNeedEncode: Resolution, frame rate and crop need the video to be re-encoded, not copied.
error.noEncoder: This ffmpeg has no encoder for the chosen codec.
error.hwUnknown: Still detecting your hardware. Try again in a moment.
inspector.builtinReadOnly: Built-in profiles stay as they are. Duplicate one to make it yours.
inspector.commandNone: Add a file that uses these settings to see the exact command it will run.
inspector.profileInUse_one: In use by a running conversion. You can edit it again once it's done, or duplicate it.
inspector.profileInUse_other: In use by {count} conversions right now. You can edit it again once they're done, or duplicate it.
inspector.overrideHint_one: Uses “{name}”. Changes here apply only to this file.
inspector.overrideHint_other: Uses “{name}”. Changes here apply only to these {count} files.
video.audioOnlyHint: This is an audio format: the picture is dropped and only the soundtrack is kept. Adjust it on the Audio tab.
video.tenBitHint: Smoother gradients, smaller files. Some old players can't play it.
video.twoPassHint: Hits a bitrate or size more precisely. CPU encoders only; takes twice as long.
video.deinterlaceHint: Only touches frames that are actually interlaced (TV and DVD sources).
video.tonemapHint: Converts HDR sources so they look right on normal screens.
mode.copyHint: Keeps the video exactly as it is. Instant and lossless.
mode.copyAudioHint: Keeps the audio exactly as it is.
encoder.autoHint: Best tested GPU encoder, otherwise the CPU
encoder.cpuHint: Software encoding: slower, often slightly more efficient
rate.sizeHint: Aim for this size per file
rate.cqTitle: Constant quality as a CRF/CQ number, like in HandBrake
rate.cqHint: Lower = better picture, bigger file. Same number for NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and the CPU; AV1 gets the equivalent on its own scale.
rate.ceilingHint: Constrained quality: keep the CQ, but never go above a bitrate.
rate.ceilingNo: {name} can't cap the bitrate in CQ mode on this graphics card. Choose CPU under “Runs on”, or use Bitrate (VBR or CBR).
rate.vbrHint: Average video bitrate. Busy scenes get more, calm ones less.
rate.cbrHint: Exactly this bitrate the whole time. For streaming and devices that need it.
video.presetHint: Sets the shorter side, so upright videos work too. Never scaled up.
fit.padHint: The whole picture fits inside; black bars fill the rest.
fit.cropHint: The picture fills the frame; what sticks out is cut off.
fit.stretchHint: The picture is squeezed to the size. Distorts it.
speed.slowestHint: Squeezes out the last few percent. Much slower.
audio.copyHint: Tracks that don't fit the container are converted automatically.
audio.normalizeHint: EBU R128: quiet films get louder, loud ones quieter.
audio.tracksHint: Films often carry several languages or commentaries.
subs.copyHint: Switchable in the player. MP4 keeps text subtitles; MKV keeps everything.
subs.burnHint: Always visible, works on every device. Needs the video to be converted.
output.keepMetadataHint: Title, date, encoder tags and the like.
output.fastStartHint: Moves the index to the front so playback starts before the whole file has loaded.
output.extraArgsHint: Added just before the output file. Use quotes for values with spaces.
launch.name: Name
launch.templateHint: {name} is the complete original name, dots and brackets included.
launch.tokensHint: Tokens are filled in per file. The original name is never cut.
launch.keepStructureHint: Recreate the dropped folder's sub-folders in the target folder
launch.idle: Add some files to get started
launch.pauseHint: Freeze running conversions and hold the queue
launch.pauseHintNoSuspend: Let running conversions finish, then hold the queue
launch.addToRunHint: Add the files that are ready to the running conversion
token.name: original name
log.title: Command & log · {name}
log.noCommand: Not built yet: the command appears once the file is ready.
drop.title: Drop to add
drop.text: Videos, audio files and whole folders
settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Missing your language? Translations are plain JSON files, so adding one is easy.
settings.soundHint: A short sound when the queue is done.
settings.openFolderHint: Shows the last converted file in your file manager.
settings.parallelHint: 2–3 suits most GPUs. Consumer NVIDIA cards allow a limited number of sessions.
settings.hwDecodeHint: Faster. Switch it off if a file refuses to convert.
settings.pauseNote: On Windows, Pause lets running conversions finish and holds the rest.
settings.matrixHint: Every encoder is tested with a short real encode. ✓ = works on this machine.
ffmpeg.missingText: ZVideoConverter uses ffmpeg, the engine behind almost every video tool, to do the actual work. It isn't installed yet. Download it with one click (about 100 MB) or point to an existing copy.
ffmpeg.updateHint: Download the newest GPL build into the app folder
ffmpeg.downloadNote: A static GPL build from BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds with NVENC, AMF, VA-API and Quick Sync. Checked against its SHA-256 before use and kept inside the app's own folder.
ffmpeg.customPathHint: A folder containing ffmpeg and ffprobe. Leave empty to find it automatically.
ffmpeg.license: ffmpeg is a separate program by the FFmpeg developers, licensed under the (L)GPL. ZVideoConverter runs it as a separate process.
about.title: About
about.tagline: A free, open-source bulk video converter. Everything happens in one window, your graphics card does the heavy lifting, and file names stay exactly as they were.
about.ffmpeg: Converts with FFmpeg {version}, © the FFmpeg developers, (L)GPL.
profiles.rowHint: Click: use this profile · Double-click: edit it
profiles.rowHintBuiltin: Click: use this profile · Double-click: make an editable copy
guide.addText: Drag videos or whole folders in. Sub-folders are searched too.
guide.profileText: On the left. Fine-tune it on the right, or only for the files you select.
guide.convertText: Names come out exactly as they went in: dots, [brackets] and all.
launch.nothingReady: Nothing left to convert. Add files or use “Convert again”.
inspector.head: Settings
inspector.collapse: Fold the settings away (they open again when you edit a profile)
inspector.switchFilesHint: Change settings only for the selected files
video.gpuLegend: your graphics card can encode this codec
about.author: Author on GitHub
settings.keepDatesHint: The new file gets the original's date instead of today's. Media libraries and photo apps sort by it.
settings.originals.trashHint: After the new file has been checked, the original goes to the trash. You can restore it from the list.
settings.originals.deleteHint: After the new file has been checked, the original is deleted permanently. There is no undo.
settings.lowPriorityHint: Converts at lower priority so games, browsers and editing stay smooth. Barely slower when the PC is idle.
original.restoredToast: The original is back in its folder.
original.notInTrash: The original isn't in the trash any more.
original.kept.verifyFailed: Original kept: the new file didn't pass the check
original.kept.error: Original kept: it couldn't be removed
video.cropAutoHint: Black bars are detected per file when converting starts.
lang.keepAudioHint: Only these audio tracks are kept, the first one becomes the default. If a file has none of them, its first track is kept.
lang.keepSubsHint: Only subtitles in these languages are kept. Subtitles without a language tag are dropped when a filter is set.
file.useSubFiles_one: Use the subtitle file next to the video
file.useSubFiles_other: Use the {count} subtitle files next to the video
crop.none: No black bars found in this file.
note.noBlackBars: No black bars were found, so nothing is cropped.
note.noLanguageMatch: None of the audio tracks is in a chosen language, so the first track is kept.
preview.title: Preview
preview.hint: Encodes 10 seconds from the middle with these exact settings and plays them, so you can judge the quality and get a measured size.
preview.stale: Settings changed since the last preview.
space.title: Not enough free space?
space.text: The converted files probably won't fit:
when.label: When done
when.failedNote_one: 1 file failed; its log stays available until then.
when.failedNote_other: {count} files failed; their logs stay available until then.
when.hint: Resets every time the app starts.
tools.retryHint: Put failed and cancelled files back in the queue
compare.title: Before / after · {name}
compare.hint: Drag across the picture to move the split.
extras.title: Also create
extras.hint: More files from the same video in one run, e.g. an MP3 of the soundtrack next to the MP4.
watch.intro: New videos that appear in these folders are converted automatically with the chosen profile, using the output and name settings from the bottom bar.
watch.note: A file is picked up once it has stopped growing (so downloads and copies finish first). Files already in the folder, and files ZVideoConverter wrote itself, are ignored.
watch.found: New file in a watched folder: {name}
update.settingHint: Once a day, asks zsync.eu whether there's a newer version. Nothing is downloaded or sent.
intro.skip: Click or press any key to skip
settings.introHint: The short film-leader countdown when the app starts.
welcome.title: Welcome to ZVideoConverter
welcome.text: Convert whole folders of video in one window, on your graphics card, without touching your file names.
welcome.cpuReady: Ready. No usable GPU encoder found, so the CPU will encode.
welcome.noFfmpeg: One thing first: ffmpeg is needed. It's a single click in the middle pane.
tour.againHint: A one-minute walk through the window.
tour.finish: You're set. Press {keys} any time to find any action.
tour.files.title: 1 · Your files
tour.files.text: Drop videos or whole folders here. Sub-folders are searched too. No videos at hand? Load three short samples with tricky names.
tour.name.title: The new name
tour.name.text: This is the name the file will get. It's never cut off: dots and [brackets] stay exactly as they were.
tour.profiles.title: 2 · Profiles
tour.profiles.text: Click a profile to use it. Double-click or press F2 to edit it: your own profiles save as you type.
tour.settings.title: Fine-tuning
tour.settings.text: Change quality, size, audio and subtitles here. With files selected, choose whether you're changing only those files or the whole profile.
tour.gpu.title: Your graphics card
tour.gpu.text: Your GPU does the encoding. Only encoders that passed a real test encode are used, and a failed GPU encode is redone on the CPU.
tour.output.title: 3 · Where and how
tour.output.text: Where the files go and how they're named. {name} is always the complete original name.
tour.summary.title: Before you start
tour.summary.text: This line says exactly what will happen: how many files, which profile, on which encoder, and where they're saved.
tour.convert.title: Convert
tour.convert.text: Press Convert. You can pause, cancel or add more files while it runs.
